answer: Continuous Co-presence Ledger: each identity must emit a steady stream of low-cost micro-attestations tied to a unique, physically sequential event (a sparrow sighting log, a saffron batch timestamp, a local ripple reading) that any node can cross-verify. Clones cannot reuse one event; forgeries create detectable ripple mismatches. Cost to an attacker: sustained real-world presence across N distinct events, linear in identities, not payable in capital.
